exact_after_finding.title: Five racemic malate aliases resolve an S-specific disodium owner
exact_after_finding.description: Current CHEBI:91261 is disodium (S)-malate. Five active DL/racemate synonyms conflict with that stereospecific identity: DL-Na-malate, Na-DL-malate, Na2-DL-malate, Sodium DL-malate and DL-Sodium malate. The isolated proposal rejects those five strings while preserving provenance. Remaining source uncertainty about sodium stoichiometry and hydration is separate and does not negate this confirmed owner defect.
